item.title: About
item.description:
Blockchain & Backend Engineer — I build serious infrastructure, not demos.

I’m a blockchain and backend engineer with 4 years in web3 and 2 years building backend systems. I work primarily in Go, Solidity, and Rust — focused on protocol architecture, smart contract engineering, and large-scale distributed systems.

What I Do

  • Backend Engineering — Large-scale system design in Go. APIs, distributed systems, high-throughput infrastructure.
  • Smart Contract Engineering — Solidity and Rust. Protocol design, DeFi mechanics, on-chain systems.
  • Blockchain Infrastructure — Deep research and implementation across modern DeFi and cross-chain architectures.

Tech Stack

Go Solidity Rust SVM/EVM Foundry Docker Kafka RabbitMQ TypeScript NestJS
